objective_for_doctor: Evaluate a 34-year-old woman requesting prenatal care, with subjective feelings of pregnancy but negative urine β-hCG.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’m a 34-year-old woman, and I’ve been trying to conceive for about 6 months since stopping my oral contraceptives. For the past two months I’ve had breast tenderness, nausea, about a 6.6-lb weight gain, urinary frequency, and increased fatigue—I’m concerned I might be pregnant.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin excoriations—like small scratches, open sore spots, or areas where the skin looks rubbed raw—anywhere on your body? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any skin excoriations, scratches, or open sore spots anywhere on my body.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone says you stop, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any episodes where I stop breathing or have pauses during sleep, and I don’t wake up gasping.”

turns.doctor_question: After your recent minor injury or fall, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the injured area? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t had any recent minor injury or fall, and I haven’t noticed severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any injured area.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist or any skin changes compared to the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, from a bump, fall, or even without a clear injury)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bruising on my chest wall—no clear bumps or even unexplained bruises.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances that could affect your health—such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs—either recently or in the past?
turns.patient_answer: “Socially I drink alcohol, and I don’t smoke or use nicotine. I haven’t used cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or any other drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time?
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine; I’m just going more often than usual, but I can make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, or growths anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even if they were mild or only a few drops)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds recently—nothing even mild or a few drops.”
